# INT8 deployment study (supplementary, post-test; generated by scripts/int8_study.py)

Models: all 459 archived final models. Variants are rebuilt from them without retraining.

- int8-dense logits identical to the archived INT8 graph on all session-2 trials: **True**
- fp32-spatial-first: largest logit difference from archived FP32 on session-1 inputs **4.3e-06**; lowest per-model prediction agreement on session 2 **100.00%**
